lines.text_source: You must be brave to stand before me, witch, after everything you've done to me!
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Você precisa ser corajoso para se manter diante de mim, bruxa, após tudo que fez comigo!
lines.risk_notes: Identity of speaker (Galath) not in voice_cards; using contemporary formal pt-BR. Emotional intensity preserved.

lines.text_source: Would you rather have turned to dust and bones?
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.base_translation: Preferia ter virado pó e ossos?

lines.text_source: I would've survived an arrow if you hadn't dragged me here!
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Eu teria sobrevivido a uma flecha se você não me tivesse trazido para cá!

lines.text_source: If there's one thing that's certain, mortal, it's that our gift makes no mistakes. Calm your rage.
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.base_translation: Se há uma coisa certa, mortal, é que nosso dom não erra. Acalme sua ira.

lines.text_source: Mistakes like bringing still-living soldiers from Zarga to the afterlife?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Erros como trazer soldados ainda vivos de Zarga para o pós-vida?
lines.risk_notes: Zarga is proper noun (preserve verbatim per decision log). Tense shift (bringing = past action) significant to plot.

lines.text_source: Zarga?
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.base_translation: Zarga?
lines.risk_notes: Very short line; interjeition-like. Conveys dawning understanding.

lines.text_source: Oh... THOSE soldiers...
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.base_translation: Ah... AQUELES soldados...
lines.risk_notes: Natural pause + realization. Solene register maintained.

lines.text_source: Tsk...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Tsk...
lines.risk_notes: Onomatopoeia. 'Tsk' localizes to Portuguese as 'Tsk' or 'Pff'; 'Tsk' is recognizable in BR game text.

lines.text_source: I have absolutely no idea why they were brought in that state, but it is exactly them I have come to speak to you about.
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.intent: statement of partial ignorance and redirection to purpose
lines.base_translation: Não tenho absolutamente nenhuma ideia de por que foram trazidos nesse estado, mas é exatamente deles que vim falar com você.
lines.risk_notes: Long line (120 bytes); tested for byte overflow. Formal register preserved without contractions. No spoiler risk.

lines.text_source: I don't plan on hanging around here much longer, so be quick.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Não pretendo ficar por aqui muito mais tempo, então seja rápido.

lines.text_source: I have seen the hate you have for them, though you don't have to be particularly observant to notice it, I must say.
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.intent: observation with rhetorical air, light mockery
lines.base_translation: Eu vi o ódio que carrega deles, embora não seja preciso ser particularmente observador para notar, devo dizer.
lines.risk_notes: Long line (116 bytes). Solene register and no contractions maintained. Phrase structure preserved without simplification.

lines.text_source: I would like to propose an alliance both of us would benefit from.
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.base_translation: Gostaria de propor uma aliança da qual ambos nos beneficiaríamos.

lines.text_source: Go on...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Prossiga...
lines.risk_notes: Brief phrase shows wariness and attention.

lines.text_source: You want to finish them and I want to finish... certain plans.
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.base_translation: Você quer terminá-los e eu quero terminar... certos planos.

lines.text_source: Why don't you do it yourself? Unlike the others, you seem to take things into your own hands.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Por que você não faz isso você mesma? Ao contrário dos outros, você parece agir com as próprias mãos.

lines.text_source: How observant you are!
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.intent: acknowledgment of acuity with light irony
lines.base_translation: Como você é perspicaz!

lines.text_source: Unfortunately, my enemies have developed a talent for disposing of my minions. I no longer have any use for these parasites.
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.intent: explanation of weakness and pragmatic disposal of assets
lines.base_translation: Infelizmente, meus inimigos desenvolveram talento em eliminar meus servos. Esses parasitas não me servem mais.
lines.risk_notes: Long line (124 bytes). Key plot exposition: minions disposed due to enemy competence. Back-translation required. Byte budget tight; concision maintained without sacrificing solene register.

lines.text_source: And I suppose that's where I come in?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: E suponho que é aí que eu entro?

lines.text_source: With an ally like you, their magic won't save them.
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.base_translation: Com um aliado como você, sua magia não os salvará.

lines.text_source: But first, we must do something about your rather limited power.
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.base_translation: Mas primeiro, precisamos lidar com seu poder bastante limitado.

lines.text_source: Grrr... Don't mock me, Valkyrie. Tell me your plan?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.intent: demand masked as irritation; request for clarity
lines.base_translation: Grrr... Não me zombe, Valquíria. Qual é seu plano?
lines.risk_notes: Speaker responds to perceived mockery. 'Valkyrie' → 'Valquíria' per decision log. Wrathful tone preserved.

lines.text_source: Let's just say... You'll be skipping a few lessons ahead.
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.intent: cryptic assurance of accelerated training or power gain
lines.base_translation: Digamos apenas... Você pulará alguns degraus adiante.
lines.risk_notes: Phrase 'skipping a few lessons ahead' is metaphorical; translated as jumping stages of advancement. Solene register maintained.

lines.text_source: Pack your bags. We're going to Ragnarok.
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.intent: directive command, introduction of significant location
lines.base_translation: Arrume suas coisas. Vamos para Ragnarok.
lines.risk_notes: Ragnarok is proper noun (preserve per decision log). Byte budget very tight (40). Solemn declarative tone essential; no contraction. Mythological weight preserved.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.risk_notes: Ellipsis represents speechlessness and weight of revelation.

lines.text_source: Alright, I have nothing left to lose.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Certo, não tenho nada mais a perder.

lines.text_source: That's not the spirit I expected, but it'll do.
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.base_translation: Esse não é o espírito que esperava, mas servirá.

lines.text_source: We have a pact now, mortal.
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.intent: declaration of binding pact, ritual formality
lines.base_translation: Temos um pacto agora, mortal.

lines.text_source: Whatever you say...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Como você desejar...

lines.text_source: You won't regret it.
lines.speaker: Valkirie
lines.base_translation: Você não se arrependerá.
